register.labelZh: ORDER 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 當沒有人想煮飯或沒有時間煮飯時,order in 和 order out 能幫助你自然地談論叫外賣。；order somebody around 可以描述某人不斷吩咐或使喚別人。；order somebody off 可以描述司機、球證或負責人命令某人下車或離開某處。；這些表達顯示 ORDER 既可以用來談論叫外賣,也可以用來表示向別人發出強硬命令。
register.summaryEn: Order in and order out help you talk about choosing takeaway food when nobody wants or has time to cook. Order somebody around describes a person who keeps telling other people what to do. Order somebody off can describe a driver, referee or person in charge telling somebody to leave a vehicle or place. These expressions show that ORDER can relate to food delivery or to giving people strong commands.
